summary_1line: Krishna laments his absence during the dice game and declares he would have stopped it, condemning gambling and promising support to the distressed Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands among the grieving Pandavas and their allies, speaking passionately as they listen in the forest after their humiliation.
Krishna raises his hand while declaring he would have stopped the dice game, his expression fierce as the exiled Pandavas sit in sorrow nearby.
